items.headline: U.S. Futures Edge Higher Ahead of Key Inflation Data; Oil Prices Climb Amid Middle East Tensions
items.summary: U.S. stock futures advanced this morning as investors awaited the crucial July Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, which was released today. This comes after major U.S. indices closed lower on Tuesday. Meanwhile, oil prices continued to rise due to renewed tensions in the Middle East. Not financial advice.

items.headline: CoreWeave Soars on Strong Earnings
items.summary: Cloud computing firm CoreWeave surged 18% in pre-market trading after reporting strong second-quarter earnings that exceeded analyst expectations, with revenue nearly doubling year-over-year.

items.headline: Hyliion Holdings Jumps on Revenue Forecast Boost
items.summary: Hyliion Holdings, a manufacturer of power modules, jumped 23% in pre-market after boosting its full-year revenue forecast.

items.headline: Cava Group Rises on Robust Q2 Results
items.summary: Cava Group climbed 16% in pre-market trading following strong second-quarter financial results that surpassed Wall Street estimates.

items.headline: H&R Block Gains on Beat-and-Raise
items.summary: H&R Block gained 12% in pre-market trading after posting better-than-expected fourth-quarter results and providing a stronger-than-expected full-year forecast.

items.headline: Super Micro Computer Surges on Upbeat Forecast
items.summary: Super Micro Computer surged 9% in pre-market trading after beating earnings expectations and offering an upbeat first-quarter forecast, reflecting accelerating demand for AI infrastructure.

items.headline: Quantum Sees Significant Intraday Gain
items.summary: Quantum ($QMCO) gained 64.7% today, highlighting an extreme move in an individual stock amidst a broadly quiet day for major indices.

items.headline: Neurocrine Biosciences Slides on Safety Concerns
items.summary: Neurocrine Biosciences fell 6.5% in pre-market due to renewed safety concerns tied to its Prader-Willi syndrome treatment and lingering questions over future drug-pricing policy.

items.headline: US Antimony Corp. Drops on Cut Outlook
items.summary: US Antimony Corp. fell 16% in pre-market after the miner and precious metals refiner cut its full-year outlook for gross revenue.

items.headline: Performance Food Group Misses Forecasts
items.summary: Performance Food Group lost 4.5% in pre-market after the food service distributor missed fourth-quarter forecasts.

items.headline: PDS Biotechnology Experiences Significant Decline
items.summary: PDS Biotechnology ($PDSB) lost 64.9% today, marking a substantial decline in individual stock performance.

items.headline: July CPI Report Released Today, Inflationary Pressures Persist
items.summary: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) for July 2026 rose 0.1% month-over-month on a seasonally adjusted basis. The all-items index increased 3.4% over the last 12 months before seasonal adjustment, with the core CPI (excluding food and energy) rising 0.2% monthly and 2.5% annually. These figures are crucial for the Federal Reserve's future interest rate decisions.

items.headline: Oil Prices Advance Amid Escalating Middle East Tensions
items.summary: Oil prices are on the rise today as renewed tensions in the Middle East, including reported fatalities from attacks on Red Sea shipping and U.S. forces firing missiles at a container ship, fuel concerns over potential supply disruptions. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude rose 0.60% to $83.70 per barrel, while Brent crude climbed 0.37% to $89.24 per barrel.

items.headline: Technology and AI Firms' Earnings Fuel Pre-Market Gains
items.summary: Upbeat quarterly results from several technology and AI infrastructure companies, including CoreWeave ($CRWV), Super Micro Computer ($SMCI), and H&R Block ($HRB), contributed to positive pre-market sentiment. These results are reviving investor appetite for tech stocks, particularly those related to the booming artificial intelligence market.

items.headline: WhiteFiber Inc. Reports Q2 Results, Focuses on AI Infrastructure Expansion
items.summary: WhiteFiber Inc. ($WYFI) announced its second-quarter 2026 financial results, highlighting a move from construction into active customer deployment at its NC-1 flagship site and new multi-year Cloud Services agreements representing over half a billion dollars in contract value. The company aims for an initial commercial launch of its cross-data-center networking solution in Q3 2026.
